question: How can I rename a section in my API Reference documentation?
ground_truth: To rename a section in your API Reference, use the `section` property in your `docs.yml` and reference the `lowerCamelCase` version of the original service file name (Fern Definition) or tag name (OpenAPI) in `referenced-packages`. For example, to rename a section to "Billing", you would specify `section: "Billing"` and include the original tag/service file name in `referenced-packages: - billing`.

metadata.cited_context:
To override the display name of a section, use the `section` property in your `docs.yml` and reference the `lowerCamelCase` version of the original service file name (Fern Definition) or tag name (OpenAPI) in `referenced-packages`.

```yaml title="docs.yml" {{4-6}}
navigation: 
  - api: API Reference
    layout:
      - section: "Billing" # New section display name
        referenced-packages: 
          - billing # lowerCamelCase version of original tag/service file name from your spec
        contents: []
      - section: "Bank Accounts"
        referenced-packages: 
          - bankAccounts
        contents: []
```
